`src/indieweb/`: Django IndieAuth/Micropub/Webmention app (`management/`, `templatetags/`, `templates/`, `static/`). `tests/`: Pytest using `tests.settings` via `DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE`; mirrors modules/fixtures. `docs/`: Sphinx (`just docs`). `examples/`, `example_project.py`, `client.py`: integrations/smoke tests.

Install: `uv sync` (or `just install`). Tests: `uv run pytest` (or `just test`); targeted: `uv run pytest tests/test_file.py::TestClass::test_case -v`. Types: `uv run mypy` (or `just typecheck`). Lint/format: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .` (119 chars, double quotes). Matrix/hooks: `tox` or `tox -e pre-commit`. Docs: `just docs`.

Python 3.10+, 4 spaces; type-annotate public functions/classes. Ruff `E,W,F,I,B,UP,DJ`; avoid unused/dead code. Naming: files/modules/functions `snake_case`, classes `PascalCase`, settings/constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Preserve app boundaries: views/handlers in `indieweb`, templates in `templates/indieweb/`, assets in `static/indieweb/`. New behavior requires `tests/test_*.py`, mirroring modules. Tests use `--cov-config=pyproject.toml` and reuse DB; reset/mark transactional schema tests. Add focused regression tests; prefer fixtures. Fast iteration: `pytest -k "keyword"` or `just test-one path::node`.

Beads: `.beads/`; daemon off with `BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1` and `BEADS_DIR="$PWD/.beads"`. Start: `bd update <bead-id> --status in_progress`; read context/deps: `bd --no-daemon --no-db show <bead-id>` and `bd --no-daemon --no-db dep tree <bead-id>`. Read referenced specs/PRDs first. Beads comments’ first non-empty line must be `Ready for review:`, `LGTM`, or `Changes requested:`; include summary/validation. Avoid `bd sync` unless asked; worktrees: `bd --no-daemon sync --flush-only`. Defaults: implementer `codex`, reviewer `claude`; configure `beadsflow.toml` or env vars. Use local `../beadsflow`, e.g. `uv run --project ../beadsflow beadsflow run <epic-id> ...`.

Use short imperative scoped commits. Before PR: `uv run pytest`, `uv run mypy`, `uv run ruff check .`; report notable outputs. PRs: change, impact, tests, related issues; screenshots/API samples for user-facing changes. Update docs/examples and state migration implications. Never commit secrets/tokens; use environment variables. Validate endpoints early; typed interfaces for HTTP. Migrations: `indieweb/migrations/`; run/check tests.

**When ending a work session**, you MUST complete ALL steps below. Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds.
1. **File issues for remaining work** - Create issues for anything that needs follow-up
2. **Run quality gates** (if code changed) - Tests, linters, builds
3. **Update issue status** - Close finished work, update in-progress items
4. **PUSH TO REMOTE** - This is MANDATORY:
git pull --rebase
git status  # MUST show "up to date with origin"
5. **Clean up** - Clear stashes, prune remote branches
6. **Verify** - All changes committed AND pushed
7. **Hand off** - Provide context for next session
Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds
NEVER stop before pushing - that leaves work stranded locally
NEVER say "ready to push when you are" - YOU must push
If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds
